info.album: Songs In The Key Of Life

podcast.body: Inspired by a Motown picnic in the summer of 1976, Stevie Wonder went directly to the recording studio afterward to capture the festive vibe. He worked out the lyrics at 3 a.m., calling his bass player back to the studio. The song notably features Stevie's sister saying "you nasty boy." Released as the first single from "Songs in the Key of Life" in November 1976, it hit number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in January 1977 and remained number one on the soul chart for over a month. "I wish was released as the first single from songs in the key of life in November 1976 nearly two months after the album came out and it made it to number one on the billboard hot 100 in January of 1977 and it made it to number one on the soul chart and stayed there for over a month."
